title: The Chamber of Things That Refuse Sight

features.name: hidden archive
features.desc-on-touch: Things filed here refuse to let themselves be indexed. The more you look, the less you see. The archive protects its own opacity.

features.name: layered dark
features.desc-on-touch: You know something is here. You can feel it in the density. But every time you focus, it slides sideways into another thing, another hiding place.

features.name: corruption bloom
features.desc-on-touch: The corruption loves this chamber. Here it doesn't alter files — it simply helps them achieve what they always wanted: invisibility.

features.name: witness stack
features.desc-on-touch: Things piled so densely that the room itself becomes a kind of forgetting. To see one thing, ten others must remain unseen.

features.name: refusal architecture
features.desc-on-touch: The walls themselves are built from what chose not to be archived. The structure is made of secrets that never asked for keeping.

features.name: veiled pool
features.desc-on-touch: Light goes into this pool and comes back changed — it forgets what it illuminated. The pool keeps what it touches to itself.

inscription: darkness perfects what it does not have to explain
